description: Look up a domain's live DNS and grade its email authentication: DMARC, SPF, DKIM (common selectors), MX, BIMI and MTA-STS. Returns each record, its status and the issues found, with a guide link per issue. A domain checked in the last few minutes is answered from that check.

domain.description: The domain to check, like example.com. A URL or www. host is reduced to the domain.

name: check_domain
title: Check a domain's email authentication
